From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACE registration & technical evidence request - Novasystems co-sell

Hi Sara / Paul,

Thanks for the quick sync last week — following up here to formally start the ACE registration for Novasystems. Paul, great to meet you on the call. Novasystems is targeting an initial pilot to embed LLM-based search and summarization into their support portal (est. 50k queries/mo). We think Redwood + quantized model variant will meet latency/cost targets.

Sara — can you point me to the minimal evidence package AWS needs for ACE intake? I've attached our recommended preflight checklist to speed validation. Specifically we can provide:
- SOC2 report excerpt and control matrix
- Network diagram and egress pattern
- Data retention and encryption summary

Paul — can you confirm the right technical contact on your side for network/VPC peering and whether Novasystems requires a dedicated region?

Next steps I propose:
1) AWS PDM confirms checklist items and any missing artifacts
2) Redwood technical lead (Karthik) shares a short network/security note
3) Mutual action plan + 30-minute intake call the week of Oct 13

Attachments: [Attachment: ace_preflight_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vivik.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0112

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@amazon.com>

Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE registration & technical evidence request - Novasystems co-sell

Hi Vivek + Paul,

Thanks Vivek — helpful summary. For ACE intake we usually need the items you listed plus:
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted ok) or summary of ITGC/CC controls
- A short architecture diagram showing where customer data flows into Redwoods services
- Expected monthly spend range (ballpark is fine)

Paul — can you share a primary technical contact and preferred AWS account ID for enrollment? If Novasystems wants co-sell tracking we’ll also need a short partner value statement (1-2 sentences) that we can include in the intake form.

I'll assign a PDM intake specialist to the ticket once I have the account ID and SOC2 snapshot.

Best,
Sara Thompson
PDM, AWS Marketplace & ISV Acceleration
Amazon Web Services

Hi all — Karthik from Redwood infra team here. Adding a few technical clarifications to help with the intake: 

- Network: Novasystems will connect via VPC peering (no dedicated interconnect planned). We expect TLS 1.2+, outbound to Redwood-managed endpoints in us-west-2.
- Data in transit / at rest: all inference payloads are encrypted with customer-managed KMS per the Private offering; we can provide a short KMS integration note.
- Egress: token / response payload size will be small, peak concurrency expected 20 RPS during business hours.

I attached a short PDF with network requirements. If AWS needs a CIDR range or sample flow logs we can extract them.

Attachments: [Attachment: network_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
